title: Microsoft Places: workplace app for hybrid work comes to GCC High
summary: Hold for licensing and location-sharing qualifications. The licensing notes do not distinguish room licences from individual-desk licences or preserve the Teams Premium transition entitlement, and the data-exposure statement omits users' choice over sharing their location. The roadmap facts and listed control paths and calls are supported.

claims.claim: Places is a flexible-work workplace app with features embedded directly in Teams and Outlook.
claims.quote: Microsoft Places is an AI-powered workplace app that supports flexible work. Places features are embedded directly in Microsoft Teams and Outlook so users can access them within their normal workflow.

claims.claim: Places includes work plans, workplace presence, in-person events, room and workspace booking, desk booking, Places finder and analytics.
claims.quote: Work plans and workplace presence; In-person events and hybrid RSVP; Book room and workspaces (also known as desk pools); Places finder; Places analytics

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Work plans let users schedule when they intend to be in the office so coworkers can coordinate.
claims.quote: Set your work location schedule in advance so coworkers know when you plan to be in the office or work remotely.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Work plans and workplace presence publish each user's planned and actual office days to colleagues.
claims.quote: Users choose whether to share their work location with coworkers in Teams and Outlook calendar settings. When sharing is enabled, coworkers can see work-location signals (in the office, in a specific building, or remote), whether the location was set manually or automatically.
claims.fix: Replace the first Data exposure sentence with 'Users choose whether to share their work location with coworkers in Teams and Outlook calendar settings; when sharing is enabled, coworkers can see manually or automatically set work-location signals.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/places/frequently-asked-questions. Retain the narrower work-plan scheduling description elsewhere.
